purpose: Describe a response to a request, expectation, or support.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
In response to requests, we extended our opening hours.
The athlete waved in response to the cheers.
I want to prepare thoroughly so I can live up to expectations.
restrictions: The action answers an external wish or expectation.
mistake: Use に応じて for adjustment to changing conditions.
